decisions.decision: Dispositions carry CI-EXEMPT with wording honest to OUR case (D-10)
decisions.rationale: Operator-confirmed. The citation guard executes cited nodes in the required job and fails on a clean skip; our tests skip there by design. Both existing precedents say 'CI cannot run this', which is FALSE for us - CI does run these nodes, in the Browser E2E job. Borrowing that phrasing would put a false statement in the honesty record.
